rules: Wide 16:9 educational editorial illustration. Sophisticated warm ivory background, sage green, deep petrol outlines and muted ochre. Gentle paper texture, clean expressive hand-drawn diagrams, coherent with a university textbook lecture. No words, letters, numerals, logos, labels or watermark anywhere. Clear visually meaningful composition, generous empty margins. Two equal scenes separated by a generous gap. LEFT: a worker at a fruit sorting bench follows a rigid pictorial instruction card: apples go in one basket, pears in another; their hand traces a clear illustrated rule, with a mechanical chute doing exactly the rule. RIGHT: an apprentice examines several labeled-by-shape example trays of apples and pears; a mentor points to examples, then the apprentice sorts a NEW fruit from a separate small test tray. Make contrast explicit instruction vs learning from examples instantly understandable. Do not draw neural network circles, flowchart boxes or robot heads.
hebb: Wide 16:9 educational editorial illustration. Sophisticated warm ivory background, sage green, deep petrol outlines and muted ochre. FIRST already has a faint narrow existing path from bottom left toward top right. SECOND repeated footprints along that same path make it visibly worn. THIRD the same route is broad and clearly worn, while surrounding grass remains. The route already exists in panel one; this represents strengthening an existing connection, not creation from nothing. No text. No people required. Gentle organic forms, elegant restrained educational illustration.
